name: Kusanagi Chisato
source:
A woman of few words. She is a sadist at heart with a lustful thought process. She has a rather dark personality.

She finds motivation in teasing the main character, however, she doesn't enjoy just sexual acts. Sexual acts are just a part of teasing for her, and her interest in actual sexual intercourse is very low.

She is a queen by profession, she teaches and does sex work as a part time job. She doesn't have the mindset of making others feel good for the sake of it. Her sexual satisfaction comes from different motives, by subduing and humiliating others. 

She becomes incredibly interested and attached to the main protagonist. She also wishes to bring Suzuka into her world.
